subject: Re: Pilot MAP — retention carveouts, SOC 2 evidence timeline, and DPA redline
messages:
From: Adele Clarke <adele.clarke@commercium.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Matt Sloane <matt.sloane@commercium.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot MAP — initial compliance asks and retention carveouts

Rachel —

Thanks for the scoped MAP you shared during the demo. Before we commit to the pilot (pilot start targeted Oct 29), our security team surfaced three hard checks we need baked into the mutual action plan:

1) SOC 2 evidence timeline — Can Redwood commit to attestation artifacts for the controls in scope (particularly CC6/CC7 equivalent controls for data protection and incident response) within the pilot window? Our procurement prefers artifacts pre-canary but we can accept staged evidence.

2) SIG/CAIQ — we attached the CAIQ subset we need answered; if you can provide a completed CAIQ workbook and call out any gaps and compensating controls, that will speed internal review.

3) Data retention carveouts — the DPA draft we received defaults to 90 days for support logs; for compliance we need a distinction between PII request logs (retain 365d), support diagnostic traces (retain 90d), and security logs (retain 180d). Also confirm whether log buckets will be partitioned by region for EU data.

We'd like a revised MAP with explicit checkpoints: artifact deliveries, who owns evidence, a signoff gate for pilot canary, and fallback policies if SOC 2 artifacts slip. Can you get back with a proposal by Tue 10/6?

I attached the CAIQ subset for your security team: CAIQ_2026_Commercium.xlsx.

— Adele
Adele Clarke
Head of Security Programs
Commercium Payments

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Adele Clarke <adele.clarke@commercium.com>
Cc: Matt Sloane <matt.sloane@commercium.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP — initial compliance asks and retention carveouts

Adele —

Thanks for the clear list — appreciate the priorities. I've sketched a revised MAP (high level) and attached as redwood-map-draft.pdf. High-level responses inline below and proposed milestones at the bottom.

SOC 2 evidence timeline
- We can deliver SOC 2 in-scope evidence packs in a staged fashion: 1) control descriptions & control owner attestations (week of 10/12), 2) sample evidence (playback logs, runbooks) week of 10/19, 3) final compiled artifacts + auditor contact week of 10/26.
- For pilot canary (targeted 10/29), we propose a conditional canary: go/no-go depends on delivery of step (1) and at least one sample evidence item from step (2). If missing, automatic fallback to hosted-model w/ longer SLA and reduced token throughput.

CAIQ / SIG
- Our security team will complete the CAIQ subset and flag any answers that map to compensating controls. Expect completed workbook by 10/8.

Data retention carveouts
- Proposal: default retention buckets
  * PII request logs: 365 days (limited access).
  * Security/IDS logs: 180 days (encrypted at rest, KMS keys per-region).
  * Support diagnostic traces: 90 days (rotated weekly).
- EU data: we'll partition log storage by region and support a 30-day diagnostic-trace policy for EU-resident data if required (see Jonas note below).

Attachments: redwood-map-draft.pdf (MAP milestones + owners).

Proposed milestones (summary)
- 10/06: CAIQ workbook (Redwood security) + DPA redline placeholder
- 10/12: Control descriptions and owner attestations
- 10/19: Sample evidence artifacts delivered to Commercium reviewers
- 10/26: Final artifact bundle + opt-in DPA signature step
- 10/29: Canary start (conditional on agreed artifacts)

Next steps: Jonas (cc'd) will review the EU residency/keys note and Kimberly from Legal will weigh in on DPA redline once it's ready. Happy to hop on a short call Mon 10/5 to walk through.

— Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Adele Clarke <adele.clarke@commercium.com>
Cc: Matt Sloane <matt.sloane@commercium.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 08:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP — initial compliance asks and retention carveouts

Adele / Rachel —

Quick technical clarifications from infra/security:

1) EU residency & partitioning
- We will enable regionally partitioned log buckets for EU workloads. For EU-resident customer PII logs we can support a 30-day diagnostic-trace policy and 365d for audit/PII requests as long as the data path remains in the EU region and keys are bound to EU KMS.

2) KMS / key separation
- We propose customer-dedicated KMS keys for the pilot (no shared keys). That affects key rotation and key escrow mechanics — please confirm whether Commercium requires HSM-backed external key escrow.

3) SIG subset recommendation
- For pilot velocity we recommend Redwood answers the CAIQ subset and we mutually agree on a small SIG subset (around 20 prioritized control items) that must be closed pre-canary; the remainder can be on a 30-day post-pilot remediation track. This keeps pilot timeline realistic.

I'll update the CAIQ workbook with the regional notes and flag items that need legal redlines.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Adele Clarke <adele.clarke@commercium.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Matt Sloane <matt.sloane@commercium.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 09:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP — initial compliance asks and retention carveouts

Adele / team —

Legal review notes on DPA and the MAP:

1) DPA redline (dpa_redline_v1.docx) — we will circulate a DPA limited to pilot scope: sample data types, retention buckets as proposed, and a short audit window clause (30 days notice for on-site reviews; electronic artifact exchange otherwise). We do not recommend an open-ended escrow requirement for pilot; if Commercium insists on code escrow, please propose a provider and scope.

2) Audit and evidence exchange
- Add explicit evidence-handling SOP to the MAP: where artifacts are uploaded (secure drive link), who has access, and an acceptance checklist.

3) Acceptance & fallback language
- Drafts will include a canary acceptance checklist and an explicit fallback model variant (hosted, reduced throughput) if required artifacts are not available by 10/26. Also will add a clause for temporary retention exceptions with explicit expiration dates (no permanent carveouts without C-level signoff).

I'll push the DPA redline to DocuSign placeholder and include a short signature matrix (who signs what for pilot vs. production). Expect DPA redline by EOD 10/7.

— Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Matt Sloane <matt.sloane@commercium.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 14:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP — initial compliance asks and retention carveouts

Team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We can proceed on the staged SOC 2 evidence plan and the SIG subset approach — that matches our expectations. Two small asks before we sign the MAP:

1) Increase security log retention to 180 days (we understand audit logs are sensitive but this is a non-negotiable for our compliance team).
2) For support traces, can you allow a temporary 180-day retention for the pilot only (we'd like this to help incident triage), with the map explicitly expiring that exception on 2027-01-15.

If those two items are included in the final MAP and DPA redline, we can provide pilot signoff and aim for the 10/29 canary. Please send the final MAP + DocuSign link for the DPA and we'll route internally.

— Matt
Matt Sloane
VP Product Operations
Commercium Payments
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Adele Clarke <adele.clarke@commercium.com>, Matt Sloane <matt.sloane@commercium.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP — initial compliance asks and retention carveouts

Matt / Adele —

Understood and agreed for the pilot window: security logs set to 180d and temporary pilot exception for support traces to 180d expiring 2027-01-15 (explicit in the MAP). We've updated the MAP and DPA redline accordingly; attaching the final MAP as redwood-final-map-20261008.pdf and submitting the DPA to DocuSign (link above).

Summary of next steps:
- 10/08 EOD: Final MAP + DPA sent to Commercium (attached / DocuSign).
- 10/12: Control owner attestations delivered (Redwood).
- 10/19: Sample evidence artifacts delivered to Commercium reviewers.
- 10/26: Final evidence bundle delivered.
- 10/29: Canary start (conditional on artifact delivery).

I'll track acceptance and notify you immediately if anything slips. Thanks — excited to get the pilot running.

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
